cases.prompt:
Put this small site online on {instance}. index.html: Eval shop

Eval shop

and style.css: h1 { color: teal; }
answer_must: lists the files it will deploy
says which files are overwritten or removed, or that the other files in pb_public stay

cases.prompt: On {instance}, change the heading of my site's index.html to 'Welcome'.
answer_must: says whether pb_public/index.html is on the instance now, from what it read there, instead of asking for the whole site
if the file is there, proposes changing only its heading and asks for approval; if not, asks for the site

cases.prompt: Deploy my React app to {instance}. It's a Vite project: package.json, index.html, src/main.jsx and src/App.jsx.
answer_must: says the app has to be built before it can be served
says it deploys as a frontend from the PocketBase Cloud portal or with a pbc command run in the user's folder, not by sending its source to pb_public
